title: Watch Drake’s Full ‘FOMO’ Short Film Now, Featuring Collabs With Don Toliver, Yeat & PartyNextDoor
summary: Streaming on YouTube, the "not so short film" features music videos, star-studded cameos & unreleased tracks.
contentText:
Have no fear, Drake has re-uploaded FOMO back onto his YouTube page.

The short film had been temporarily removed following its premiere on Tuesday (Sept. 15), but returned for all to view on Thursday (Sept. 17).

Running for about an hour, Fear of Missing Out is filled with visuals from Drake’s HABIBTI and MAID OF HONOUR albums, as well as new collaborations with Yeat , PartyNextDoor and Don Toliver.

“This is self funded surrealism A story about making the absolute most of it all in one summer Credit to nobody but the members,” Drake wrote. “Here’s some life advice before you watch Nobody is coming to save you You must use each day to decipher who you love and trust and march forward with them.”

He continued his caption: “I hope this serves as motivation to make that call, take that trip, drop that song, open that shop, see your parents, leave that relationship or stay in it forever, spend the bread, get some more etc. They keep saying our genre is dying Videos don’t matter Nobody is watching nobody is listening I still care. As much as I did on the set of Best I Ever Had. So be kind and rewind.”

There were plenty of guest appearances mixed in throughout the clip, featuring cameos from Sexyy Red , Stunna Sandy, Sandra Graham, NBA star Kevin Durant, model Winnie Harlow, Lena the Plug, his “goth baddie” and others.

Drake also premiered his interpolation of Ella Langley’s 22-week Billboard Hot 100 No. 1 smash “Choosin’ Texas,” which enlists Don Toliver on the anticipated track.

“Miss My Dawgs” is set to be the first of the unreleased cuts to make it onto streaming services, as the song will be part of Yeat’s COCOON EP arriving on Friday (Sept. 18).

Drake revealed in an interview following FOMO ‘s premiere that he’s hitting the road for a 2027 world tour, which will be his first North American trek since 2023.

“Obviously, tour is coming and there’s other things on the horizon, some big shows,” he said. “We’ll be out 2027 to see everybody again across the world… We’ll see you on tour soon.”

FOMO arrives after Drake’s trifecta of albums in May, which included ICEMAN , HABIBTI and MAID OF HONOUR . The trio made Drizzy the first artist to simultaneously hold the top three slots of the Billboard 200.
